name: Long-Form Book Production
description: A durable long-form writing workflow that prevents chapter-by-chapter amnesia.

tasks.name: Define book contract
tasks.objective: Define reader, promise, genre/form, scope, voice constraints, length, evidence/canon rules, exclusions, and what the book must cause the reader to understand, feel, or do.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The book has a specific promise and explicit non-goals.

tasks.name: Build architecture
tasks.objective: Create argument/story spine, section/chapter functions, dependency order, escalation, recurring motifs, source/canon ledger, unresolved questions, and chapter-level acceptance criteria.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Each chapter has a job that cannot be removed without changing the whole.

tasks.name: Draft chapters
tasks.objective: Draft against chapter briefs while reading the relevant preceding context, canon/source ledger, unresolved hooks, and future dependencies. Mark uncertain claims or continuity facts instead of inventing certainty.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Drafts satisfy chapter purpose without duplicating neighboring chapters.

tasks.name: Structural edit
tasks.objective: Read the manuscript as one object. Diagnose missing steps, weak causality, redundant chapters, pacing holes, unsupported arguments, abandoned setups, tonal drift, and late information that belongs earlier.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Structural problems are repaired before sentence polishing dominates effort.

tasks.name: Continuity and fact pass
tasks.objective: Check names, dates, timelines, terminology, character facts, examples, claims, citations, cross-references, promised callbacks, and repeated explanations across the complete manuscript.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Material facts and callbacks are consistent across chapters.

tasks.name: Line edit and voice pass
tasks.objective: Tighten prose for precision, rhythm, clarity, voice, paragraph logic, scene texture, and repetition while preserving intentional style. Do not use line edits to conceal unresolved structural defects.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Sentence-level changes preserve meaning and manuscript voice.

tasks.name: Package manuscript
tasks.objective: Finalize front/back matter, citation/bibliography apparatus where needed, style sheet, glossary/index inputs, permissions ledger, versioned manuscript, and editable source package for copyediting/design.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The next production stage can proceed without reconstructing editorial decisions.
